title: Bias Correction and Inference for Panel Quantile Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.36443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a large-$n$, large-$T$ theory for the unsmoothed fixed-effects quantile regression estimator, paralleling Hahn and Newey (2004) for smooth nonlinear panel models. An exact rank-score identity for the profiled criterion, with a convexity argument, delivers the leading incidental parameter bias of the slope estimator, of order $T^{-1}$, in closed form. When $n$ and $T$ grow at the same rate, the estimator is asymptotically normal but in general not centred, and conventional intervals are invalid. Admissible growth of $n$ relative to $T$, up to $n=o(T^3)$, depends on the regularity of the conditional error densities. A split-panel jackknife removes the leading bias throughout this range and yields valid inference. translated_title: 面板分位数回归的偏差校正与推断
translated_abstract: 我们为非平滑固定效应分位数回归估计量建立了大 $n$、大 $T$ 理论，与 Hahn 和 Newey (2004) 针对平滑非线性面板模型的研究相呼应。借助剖面准则的精确秩得分恒等式以及凸性论证，我们以闭式形式导出了斜率估计量 $T^{-1}$ 阶的一阶伴随参数偏差。当 $n$ 和 $T$ 以相同速度增长时，该估计量是渐近正态的，但通常不是中心化的，因此传统置信区间是无效的。$n$ 相对于 $T$ 的可容许增长速度最高可达 $n=o(T^3)$，这取决于条件误差密度的正则性。分割面板刀切法在整个范围内消除了一阶偏差并产生有效推断。在依赖性按几何或多项式速度衰减的序列相关面板中，偏差会额外增加一项来自不同时期回归量与误差之间依赖性的项，此时刀切法仍然有效……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文为固定效应面板分位数回归建立了大样本理论，以闭式形式给出伴随参数偏差，并提出分割面板刀切法消除偏差、实现有效推断，适用范围可达 $n=o(T^3)$。
en_tdlr: This paper develops large-n, large-T theory for fixed-effects panel quantile regression, derives the closed-form incidental parameter bias, and proposes a split-panel jackknife that removes the leading bias and delivers valid inference for n up to o(T^3).
